entities.name: Long QT syndrome
observations: Inherited repolarization disorder modeled in human iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes; cellular APD prolongation is a disease-relevant surrogate, not a clinical QT measurement.

source_tools.relevance: Disease context in primary iPSC study

entities.name: SCN5A
observations: SCN5A-P1332L patient-derived iPSC cardiomyocytes showed prolonged APD90 relative to a CRISPR/Cas9-corrected isogenic control.

entities.name: SCN5A-P1332L APD90
observations: In iPSC cardiomyocytes, APD90 was 646 ± 7 ms in SCN5A-P1332L cells versus 482 ± 23 ms in CRISPR/Cas9-corrected isogenic controls.

entities.name: Mexiletine
observations: Shortened APD90 in SCN5A-P1332L iPSC cardiomyocytes from 646 ± 7 ms to 560 ± 7 ms.

entities.name: SGK1-I1
observations: Shortened APD90 in SCN5A-P1332L iPSC cardiomyocytes to 518 ± 5 ms and did not shorten APD in the corrected control.

entities.name: PMID:37124559
observations: Reports SCN5A-P1332L long-QT iPSC cardiomyocyte phenotype, CRISPR/Cas9-corrected isogenic control, and pharmacologic APD responses.
